A neo-Nazi is released from prison a changed man and hopes to prevent his younger brother from following in his footsteps.

A colonel defends three of his soldiers in a court-martial after they abandon a suicidal attack.

A therapist counsels Will Hunting, a janitor with a genius IQ.
The real-life story of IPS Officer Manoj Kumar Sharma and IRS Officer Shraddha Joshi.

Two teenagers, a city boy in Tokyo and a girl in rural Japan, mysteriously begin swapping bodies, forging a connection that sends them searching for one another.
Two friends search for a brilliant, free-spirited classmate whose unconventional approach to engineering school changed their lives and challenged a rigid education system.
Scottish warrior William Wallace leads his countrymen in a rebellion to free his homeland from the tyranny of King Edward I of England.

As Andy prepares to leave for college, Woody, Buzz and the gang face an uncertain future when a mix-up sends them to a daycare center full of new toys.

The story of T.E. Lawrence, the English officer who successfully united and led the diverse, often warring, Arab tribes during World War I in order to fight the Turks.

A grumpy old man turns his house into an airship using balloons and flies off to South America with a young stowaway.

A young boy is thought to be nothing but a lazy troublemaker until the new art teacher has the patience and compassion to discover the real problem behind his struggles in school.
A New York City advertising executive goes on the run after being mistaken for a government agent by a group of foreign spies, and falls for a woman whose loyalties he begins to doubt.

A married couple have to decide whether to improve their daughter's life by moving abroad or to stay in Iran and look after a deteriorating parent with Alzheimer's disease.

items.title: 夺宝奇兵3

Two grifters team up to pull off the ultimate con.

April 6th, 1917. As an infantry battalion assembles to wage war deep in enemy territory, two soldiers are assigned to race against time and deliver a message that will stop 1,600 men from walking straight into a deadly trap.

In a futuristic city sharply divided between the working class and the city planners, the son of the city's mastermind falls in love with a working-class prophet who predicts the coming of a savior to mediate their differences.

Two bounty killers with similar intentions but different motivations team up to take down a psychotic Mexican outlaw before he and his gang can carry out an audacious bank robbery.
A story of family, religion, hatred, oil and madness, focusing on a turn-of-the-century prospector in the early days of the business.
After two male musicians witness a mob hit, they flee the state in an all-female band disguised as women, but further complications set in.

After waking from a four-year coma, a former assassin wreaks vengeance on the team of assassins who betrayed her.

Retired Old West gunslinger Will Munny reluctantly takes on one last job to avenge an injustice with the help of his old partner and a young would-be gunman calling himself "The Schofield Kid".

When an unconfident young woman is cursed with an old body by a spiteful witch, her only chance of breaking the spell lies with a self-indulgent yet insecure young wizard and his companions in his legged, walking castle.

items.subtitle: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2

An Italian epic that follows the lives of two brothers from the 1960s to the 2000s.

The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.
In a small Korean province in 1986, two detectives struggle with the case of multiple young women being found raped and murdered by an unknown culprit.
The owner of an aging high-class hotel regales a writer with tales of serving as a lobby boy under an exceptional concierge in the hotel's glory years.
Two monsters whose job is to make human children scream accidentally let a little girl into their world and must now protect her from their own kind to return her home unscathed.
A young man and woman meet on a train in Europe, and wind up spending one evening together in Vienna. Unfortunately, both know that this will probably be their only night together.
A blade runner must pursue and terminate four replicants who stole a ship in space and have returned to Earth to find their creator.
The husband of a missing woman becomes the main suspect in her disappearance.

American car designer Carroll Shelby and driver Ken Miles battle corporate interference and the laws of physics to build a revolutionary race car for Ford in order to defeat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1966.
When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

items.title: 链锯人 剧场版：蕾洁篇
items.subtitle: Chainsaw Man - The Movie: Reze Arc

extra.剧情简介: A direct sequel to the first season of the series "Chainsaw Man", featuring Denji, a young man who co-exists with a chainsaw demon. Denji encounters a new romantic interest, but will his involvement place them both in danger?

items.title: 因父之名
items.subtitle: In the Name of the Father

extra.剧情简介: An Irish man's coerced confession to an I.R.A. bombing he did not commit results in the imprisonment of his father as well. Meanwhile, a British lawyer fights to clear their names and free them.

Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.
Six short stories that explore the extremities of human behavior involving people in distress.

A deaf girl, Shoko, is bullied by the popular Shoya. As Shoya continues to bully Shoko, the class turns its back on him. Shoko transfers and Shoya grows up as an outcast. Alone and depressed, the regretful Shoya finds Shoko to make amends.
A prospector goes to the Klondike during the 1890s gold rush in hopes of making his fortune, and is smitten with a girl he sees in a dance hall.
In 1976 Melbourne, a lonely 8-year-old girl strikes up a correspondence with an unlikely pen pal: a severely obese 44-year-old New Yorker with Asperger's syndrome.
A film projectionist longs to be a detective, and puts his meagre skills to work when he is framed by a rival for stealing his girlfriend's father's pocketwatch.
A small-time Philadelphia boxer gets a supremely rare chance to fight the world heavyweight champion in a bout in which he strives to go the distance for his self-respect.

items.title: 加勒比海盗
items.subtitle: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

extra.剧情简介: An intrepid blacksmith teams up with an eccentric pirate captain to save his love from an undead pirate crew.
In a future where mutants are nearly extinct, an elderly and weary Logan leads a quiet life. But when Laura, a mutant child pursued by scientists, comes to him for help, he must get her to safety.
The lives of a group of friends are forever changed by the Vietnam War.
In a decrepit South American village, four men are hired to transport an urgent nitroglycerine shipment without the equipment that would make it safe.

After being rejected by the Confederate military, not realizing it was due to his crucial civilian role, an engineer must single-handedly recapture his beloved locomotive after it is seized by Union spies and return it through enemy lines.

A naive youth leader is appointed to fill a vacancy in the U.S. Senate. His idealistic plans promptly collide with corruption at home and subterfuge from his hero in Washington, but he tries to forge ahead despite attacks on his character.

A barber seeks vengeance after his home is burglarized, cryptically telling police his "lakshmi" has been taken, leaving them uncertain if it's a person or object. His quest to recover the elusive "lakshmi" unfolds.
An old couple visit their children and grandchildren in the city, but receive little attention.
A young novice is sent by her convent in 1930s Austria to become a governess to the seven children of a widowed naval officer.
When a tribal man is arrested for a case of alleged theft, his wife turns to a human-rights lawyer to help bring justice.
24 hours in the lives of three young men in the French suburbs the day after a violent riot.
The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.
A cyborg assassin from the future attempts to find and kill a young woman who is destined to give birth to a warrior that will lead a resistance to save humankind from extinction.

items.title: 黄金时代
items.subtitle: The Best Years of Our Lives

extra.剧情简介: Three WWII veterans return home forever changed and find it difficult to adjust to their new realities.
After living a life marked by coldness, an aging professor is forced to confront the emptiness of his existence.

An ex-prize fighter turned New Jersey longshoreman struggles to stand up to his corrupt union bosses, including his older brother, as he starts to connect with the grieving sister of one of the syndicate's victims.
An American writer of pulp westerns arrives in Vienna to meet his old friend Harry Lime, but finds that Lime has died.
While trying to lead a quiet suburban life, a family of undercover superheroes are forced into action to save the world.
Jeff "The Dude" Lebowski, mistaken for a millionaire of the same name, seeks restitution for his ruined rug and enlists his bowling buddies to help get it.

Professor Wilson discovers a lost Akita puppy on his way home. Despite objections from his wife, Hachi endears himself to the family and grows to be Parker's loyal companion. As their bond grows deeper, a beautiful relationship unfolds.
Nine years after Jesse and Celine first met, they encounter each other again on the French leg of Jesse's book tour.
A young boy befriends a giant robot from outer space that a paranoid government agent wants to destroy.

Regan MacNeil, a playful 12 year old, begins communicating with an invisible figure through a Ouija board, but as her behavior turns terrifying and doctors fail to explain it, her mother seeks help from a skeptical priest.
A little boy is held captive in a room with his mother since his birth, so he has never known the world outside.
Paul Rusesabagina, a hotel manager, houses over a thousand Tutsi refugees during their struggle against the Hutu militia in Rwanda, Africa.

Chris Taylor, a naive American, volunteers for Vietnam combat. He feels insignificant among experienced soldiers. Two sergeants, harsh Barnes and cooperative Elias, clash over an illegal killing during a raid. Chris faces meltdown.
James Hunt and Niki Lauda, two extremely skilled Formula One racers, have an intense rivalry with each other. However, it is their enmity that pushes them to their limits.
A knight returning to Sweden after the Crusades seeks answers about life, death, and the existence of God as he plays chess against the Grim Reaper during the Black Plague.
In the 1950s, fear and violence escalate as the people of Algiers fight for independence from the French government.
A writer recounts a childhood journey with his friends to view the body of a boy who went missing in the woods.

Young Dorothy Gale and her dog Toto are swept away by a tornado from their Kansas farm to the magical Land of Oz and embark on a quest with three new friends to see the Wizard, who can return her to her home and fulfill the others' wishes.
The family of a left-wing journalist is torn apart after the military coup of Turkey in 1980.
Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

items.title: 圣女贞德蒙难记
items.subtitle: The Passion of Joan of Arc

extra.剧情简介: In 1431, Jeanne d'Arc is placed on trial on charges of heresy, and the ecclesiastical jurists attempt to force her to recant her claims of holy visions.
A clash between Sultan and Shahid Khan leads to the expulsion of Khan from Wasseypur, and ignites a deadly blood feud spanning three generations.
